commissioning.title: Manual commissioning
commissioning.description: Commissioning sequence on {name}: hold button 1 for 7 s, press briefly, hold again for 7 s. Timeout: 2 min.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Commissioning telegram received
bluetooth_confirm.description: Device {mac} commissioned. Press another button to exit commissioning mode, then submit.

commissioning_retry.title: Commissioning failed
commissioning_retry.description: No valid commissioning telegram received from {name}. Before a factory reset, see the reset disclaimer in the documentation.

progress.waiting_commissioning: Waiting for the commissioning telegram (timeout 2 min). Sequence: hold button 1 for 7 s, press briefly, hold again for 7 s.

abort.no_bluetooth_discovery: This setup must start from a discovered Bluetooth device.
abort.not_enocean_prefix: This discovered device does not use the EnOcean BLE MAC prefix (E2:15).
abort.discovery_required: Devices are added from Bluetooth discovery. Press a button on the switch; it then appears as discovered under Settings → Devices & services.

error.invalid_qr: Invalid commissioning QR data: no device address (30SE215…) and 32-digit security key (+Z…) recognized.
error.commissioning_not_detected: No commissioning telegram received within 2 min.
error.invalid_commissioning: Commissioning telegram received but failed validation.
error.qr_mac_mismatch: Device address in the QR data does not match the discovered device.
error.qr_key_invalid: Security key does not authenticate the telegrams received from this device. The module may have been re-keyed by another system.
error.qr_no_telegram: No telegram received from this device yet. Press a button on the module, then resubmit.
